note: City of Belleville park at Rocky Pond, a former Rock Island Railroad water-supply pond on the south edge of town; gravel sites in a loop just west of the pond, beside the railroad. Free tent camping. Canoes and small boats with electric motors only; no open fires. --Claude
summary: City page (2018-2026) confirms 15 RV spots, 50A/water/sewer at each, $20/$125 week/$500 month, no reservations, dump; showers cleared (the showers are at City Park). Pond ~25+ acres; lakeview confirmed. Pin fine.
flags: Phone: City Office 785-527-2288 (on the parks page; also on Google). No phone stored on the entry: suggest adding 785-527-2288. Website https://www.cityofbellevillekansas.com/parks-department confirmed. Google Maps 'Rocky Pond Park' 4.6 (125 reviews).

Waterfront (stored lakeview): CONFIRMED. The pond is ~250 x 450 m on imagery (the city says the pond and surrounding land cover 48 acres), far over the ~5-acre line. The east row of the RV loop is ~35-45 m from the pond's southwest lobe across open lawn, partly screened by a grove at the north end; the park road and lawn sit between, so not lakefront.

Showers: the stored showers=true (derived from note prose / The Dyrt) is cleared to unknown: the city lists Rocky Pond's facilities as 'rest rooms, RV hookups, sewer dump...' and puts the new shower rest rooms at City Park.

Long-stay character (weak spot): the city sells $500 a month, and all 15 spots are occupied by trailers in both the Esri and NAIP imagery. That may just be imagery timing, but if the loop is mostly monthly tenants a passer-by may find no open spot (no reservations taken). Not a drop on the page's terms; AWH may want to know.
Pin 39.82896,-97.62203 sits in the grove inside the RV loop: fine.
